name: Infra compose and apps: h:compose, dotnet.container, git-sha deploys
description: Milestone 4. h:compose renders compose.yaml + 0600 .env, hash diff, up -d --remove-orphans, healthcheck wait. dotnet.container via dotnet publish -t:PublishContainer with settings from dotnet msbuild -getProperty (Luau fills gaps, conflicts fail validate). Tag = git sha, --allow-dirty, skip build if tag exists, redeploy when running tag differs. traefik labels/args. See docs infra-cli/apps-and-compose.
